That's a great question! Following a few simple steps will ensure you get the best possible sleep experience from your new mattress. 💡

Here’s how to set it up for success:

Unbox in Your Room: Move the box to the room where you'll be sleeping before you open it.
Unwrap Carefully: Place the rolled mattress on your foundation or base. Remove the outer plastic wrap, being careful not to use a sharp object that could cut the mattress.
Let it Expand: Unfold the mattress and tear away the inner plastic. It will start to expand immediately! It may take up to an hour to fully expand and a few days to fully firm up. For best performance, we recommend letting it breathe for 24 hours before sleeping on it.
Rotate Regularly: To ensure even wear over time, we recommend rotating the mattress head-to-foot every 4-6 months.
